Flanker over LAX

LAX · Runway 25R · 263° true · Su-27 Flanker

Flanker over LAX

Take off from LAX. Start the dogfight. Six bandits come over the mountains, and SAM sites wait in the hills. Hold the target in your seeker box for one second to lock. Fly low in the valleys to hide from radar. Kill fast for combo points.

Building terrain, city and airport…

Co-op · up to 4 pilots

ROOM—

    Host a room and send the code or link to your friends. The host runs the missions; everyone earns the same rewards.
